info.description: Ride management, matching, and lifecycle for drivers and passengers. Mounted at /api/rides by the gateway.
info.title: Rides API

get.description: Returns a static hello payload. Useful as a smoke test that the service is reachable.
Proxies to the location service's `/admin/drivers/active` endpoint and returns its response verbatim. Admin role required.
Returns the active in-memory matching parameters (pickup radius, dropoff radius, max passengers, min ETA, min driver distance). Admin role required.

put.description: Persists new parameters to the admin_settings table and swaps the in-memory atomic pointer so the change takes effect immediately for new requests. Admin role required.

get.description: Returns aggregated counts (total rides, by-status breakdown, total sub-rides) and derived ratios (match rate, average passengers per matched ride, cancellation rate, average wait seconds). Admin role required.
Paginated, filterable list of rides for the admin panel. Filters: status (pending/active/completed/cancelled) and search (free-text against driver id or addresses). Admin role required.

delete.description: Wipes the rides table. Used during development and integration tests; admin role required.

get.description: Returns the ride and all of its sub-rides, including cancelled and completed ones. Admin role required.
get.summary: Get a ride's full detail (admin view)

get.description: Returns the free-form JSON document holding feature flags and tunables. Schema is admin-panel-defined and not enforced server-side. Admin role required.

put.description: Stores a free-form JSON document. Body must be valid JSON, max 64 KB. Admin role required.

get.description: Returns the 2GIS map API key used by the mobile clients to render maps.
Returns the generated swagger.json. The `host` and `basePath` fields can be overridden at runtime via SWAGGER_HOST and SWAGGER_BASE_PATH env vars (useful when running behind the API gateway).
get.summary: Get the OpenAPI 2.0 spec for this service

post.description: Writes the driver's current GPS coordinates to the location service. Caller's JWT must match `driver_id`. Prefer the Socket.IO `location_update` event for high-frequency updates.

get.description: Returns database connection pool stats and a top-level status (up/down). Used by Docker healthchecks and the gateway's health filter.

post.description: Forwards caller-supplied coordinate segments to pathfinder (no 2GIS), persists the result as a pending ride, and returns the ride id. The caller's JWT must match driver_id.
post.summary: Create a driver path from a custom (driver-drawn) polyline

post.description: Calls pathfinder to build the driving route, persists it as a pending ride, and returns the ride id. The caller's JWT must match `driver_id`.

Runs the PostGIS spatial search, filters by capacity and driver position, picks the best candidate, computes the walking path to the pickup point, and creates a pending sub-ride. Synchronous alternative to the Socket.IO offer flow.
post.summary: Match a passenger to a driver (REST)

get.description: Returns every ride with status pending or active. Used by passengers browsing available drivers.

Returns paginated past rides for the authenticated user. Drivers see ride-level entries (with passenger count and total earnings); passengers see sub-ride-level entries (with the driver and price). The shape of `rides` depends on the caller's role.
Proxies to pathfinder; returns the driving route geometry and metadata.

BearerAuth.description: JWT issued by auth-service. Prefix with "Bearer ".
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
